messages:
Leo Park: Heads up — provisioning failing for ~40 nodes in eu-west-gpu-pool. OOB console output shows serial multiplexing/NAT collisions after yesterday's BMC firmware push. Nodes stuck at 'awaiting console' during PXE, GPU capacity dropping rapidly. tagging eng-infra and oncall :eyes:

infra-bot: deploy-fleet-bot completed firmware rollout v2026-03-20 to 3,820 targets. Summary: 32 failures (0.84%), 18 degraded, remainder healthy. See deploy link: https://deploys.internal/reports/2026-03-20/firmware

Anika Bose: I can repro on one of the nodes. ipmi output shows repeated sessions and the mux toggles between two addresses. log snippet: ```2026-03-20T22:05:12 bmc[serialmux]: nat collision detected, session_id=0x3f4, remote=10.240.12.9```

Samir Patel: Any evidence secure-boot flags flipped? That could explain PXE race/boot-loop. If BMC toggles the console, the bootloader might retry and toggle boot policy.

Anika Bose: Not everywhere, but on ~6 nodes EFI flags show BootOrder reverted and secureboot=enabled->disabled flips intermittently. Might be correlated with the mux collisions.

Raja Nair: This smells like the multiplexer firmware incorrectly reassigns virtual serial endpoints when IPMI sessions overlap. Quick mitigation: quarantine affected rack, remove from provisioner, and set routing to eu-central fallback to preserve clients. We should pause the remainder of the rollout.

Leo Park: Agreed. Cost note — rerouting to eu-central will push some jobs to reserved capacity and spike cross-region egress. Finance FYI: this could add ~2-3k/day for the short term.

Anika Bose: I'm going to pause the fleet rollout now (rolling back job queued). Steps I'm running: 1) pause rollout 2) mark nodes 'quarantine' in fleetdb 3) run ipmitool reset on affected BMCs 4) reattempt provisioning on a canary subset.

Samir Patel: If resetting BMC doesn't rebind the mux, we should try setting the mux master pin via solctl: 
```
for n in $(cat bad_nodes); do solctl --host $n set-master mux0; done
```

Raja Nair: Also patch runbook note: if secureboot toggled, set EFI var LockMask and re-seal keys via KMS before re-provision. Don't force reimage until we confirm no nvme/uefi variable corruption.

Anika Bose: I've opened INC-2026-487 and a rollback ticket FLT-2026-98. Pausing rollout now. Will run the BMC soft-reset command on 6 nodes as a canary and report back in 10m.

Leo Park: Thanks. tagging @platform-sre to prep capacity shifts if eu-west loses another 10% of GPUs. Also can someone scope how many dedicated customers would be impacted by moving traffic? We need to avoid SLA breaches.

Samir Patel: I'll get a list and ETA for cold migrations. If we keep affected nodes quarantined, we can avoid forced evictions for 24h.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-487 created. Priority: P2. Pager duty: @oncall-eng-infra. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-487

Anika Bose: Canary results: 4/6 BMC soft-resets recovered normal serial mux behavior, 2 remain flaky. Those 2 I'll manually power-cycle and collect full IPMI dumps. Rolling back firmware for the remaining batch and pausing further pushes. Updating tickets.

Leo Park: Good triage. Keep updates here. If rollback restores stability, we should add an automated preflight that checks for 'nat collision' strings in BMC logs before further rollouts. :thumbsup:
